name: MonarchSecretField
title: SecretField
wrapsNative: SecureField, swapped for TextField while revealed, with .privacySensitive(); UIPasteboard.setItems(_:options:) with .localOnly for copy
summary: A masked secret (API key, token, signing secret) with a reveal toggle, an optional copy button and a "set, not shown" state, over the standard SecureField and TextField.
whenToUse: When a settings screen takes or shows a credential for an integration, when a newly created key is shown once to be copied, or when the server holds a saved secret and the user may replace it.
whenNotToUse: For a sign-in password use MonarchPasswordInput, which offers saved passwords. For a value that is not sensitive use MonarchCopyField or MonarchTextField.
api: init(_ label: String, text: Binding<String>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isSet: Bool = false, isRevealable: Bool = true, isCopyable: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, isRevealed: Binding<Bool>? = nil, labels: MonarchSecretFieldLabels = MonarchSecretFieldLabels(), onCopy: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchSecretFieldLabels { init(show: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, copy: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, copied: String? = nil, copiedAnnouncement: String? = nil, setPrompt: String? = nil, setDescription: String? = nil, hidden: String? = nil, error: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: label
options.description: What the secret is, such as "API key". Shown above the field and used in the names of the reveal and copy buttons.

options.name: text
options.description: The secret. Bind a constant for a read-only secret.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

options.name: error
options.description: Error message; replaces the helper while present.

options.name: isSet
options.description: A value is saved on the server but not sent to the device. The empty field shows "Saved. Enter a new value to replace it" and the hint says a value is saved. Leaving it empty keeps the saved value; the app decides what to send.

options.name: isCopyable
options.description: Shows a copy button. It copies the current text while it stays masked.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows the secret as read-only text (masked with one dot per character until revealed) instead of an editable field.

options.name: isRevealed
options.description: Whether the secret is shown as text. Without it the component keeps the state itself, starting masked.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: show, copy, copied, copiedAnnouncement, setPrompt, setDescription, hidden and error.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Runs with the copied text after each copy.

states.name: masked
states.description: Default. A SecureField; the toggle shows an eye symbol and its value is off.

states.name: revealed
states.description: A TextField with the secret as text; the toggle shows a crossed eye and its value is on.

states.name: set, not shown
states.description: Empty with the "saved" placeholder and hint. Reveal and copy are disabled until the user types a replacement.

states.name: empty
states.description: Reveal and copy are disabled and drawn in the disabled text colour.

states.name: copied
states.description: For two seconds after a copy the copy symbol becomes a checkmark and the button is named "Copied".

states.name: read-only
states.description: The secret is text on the subtle fill, one dot per character while masked, selectable while revealed.

states.name: focused
states.description: Draws the theme's focus ring around the field.

states.name: error
states.description: Danger border, and an icon and message under the field.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle background, the disabled text colour and disabled buttons, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: The same field as MonarchTextField: a surface fill with an input border and medium corners, the secret in the monospaced code type role in the default text colour, and the reveal and copy symbols in the muted text colour at the trailing edge. The colours come from the theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The web has sm, md and lg sizes; iOS has one size, the size of MonarchTextField. The web asks browser password managers to ignore the field with autocomplete and vendor attributes; iOS has no public API that keeps the Passwords bar off a SecureField, so the system may still offer it. On iOS a copied secret is local only (not sent through Universal Clipboard); iOS has no pasteboard flag that hides an item from clipboard history. Read-only is an isReadOnly flag instead of the input's readonly attribute. Android has the same parameters.
accessibility: The field is one VoiceOver element: label, then the secure value, then a hint with the error (spoken as "Error: …"), the "saved" description when isSet and the field is empty, or the helper text.
The reveal control is given to VoiceOver as a standard Toggle named "Show <label>" in both states; its value says whether the secret is shown.
The copy button is named "Copy <label>", becomes "Copied" for two seconds, plays the success haptic and announces "Copied to clipboard".
A read-only secret is spoken as "Hidden" while masked and as its text only while revealed.
Reveal and copy are disabled while the field is empty, including a saved secret that is not shown.
A new error message is announced when it appears, and is shown with an icon and text, not colour alone.
The field and each button have a 44-point touch target, and the text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: An empty error string counts as no error.
Revealing swaps the SecureField for a TextField; focus moves to the new field when the old one had it.
The system may clear a SecureField when editing starts again after the secret was hidden.
A long read-only secret stays on one line and is shortened in the middle; copy still copies all of it.
Copy is available while the secret is masked; it never reveals it.
Autocorrection and capitalisation are off in both states.

examples.title: Shown once, with copy
examples.template:
MonarchSecretField(
    {{label}},
    text: $secret,
    helper: {{description}},
    isCopyable: true,
    isReadOnly: true
)
examples.code:
MonarchSecretField(
    "Signing secret",
    text: $secret,
    helper: "Shown once. Store it somewhere safe before you leave this page.",
    isCopyable: true,
    isReadOnly: true
)

examples.title: A token saved on the server
examples.code:
MonarchSecretField(
    "Bot token",
    text: $token,
    helper: token.isEmpty ? "Stored encrypted." : "The new token replaces the saved one when you save.",
    isSet: true
)

examples.title: A new key shown once
examples.code:
MonarchSecretField(
    "Signing secret",
    text: .constant("whsec_9d2f7a61c0b84e3f"),
    helper: "Store it somewhere safe before you leave this page.",
    isCopyable: true,
    isReadOnly: true
)
